book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Lum le

content: Nchi to wu kɛme bvuŋga a muh we sege mwɛdɛ baaŋ yu
Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, ŋgoone ki njɛ̂mɛ finɛ bɛŋ le njɛ bamii ba kee nchi. Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ nchi to wu kɛme bvuŋga a muh we sege mwɛdɛ baaŋ yu gɛ?

Besabɛŋ jo mbejɛ yi kintaashɛ ki kwɛse bɛ jwɛŋsɛ le. Nchi to wu shuude kwɛse bɛ jwɛŋsɛ gɛh sege jwɛŋsɛ baaŋ yu. Geenɛ jwɛŋsɛ ja lo wu kwe, tu kwɛse wuyu le wu bu wa a nchi wɛɛ kuu wu shuude wu bɛ jwɛɛŋ.

Noo, nɛ wu ja wu gɛɛŋ a jwɛŋsɛ wumu le, jwɛɛŋ baaŋ yu, tu ba tɛɛŋ wu lɛ kinjikuu. Geenɛ nɛ jwɛŋsɛ ja lo wu kwe, tu wu le bu wa a nchi wuyu kuu. Wu nɛ gɛnɛ lo wu taashɛ wu nyume bɛ jwɛŋsɛ wumu, tu gɛ wu ka nyume kinjikuu gɛ.

Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ no bɛŋ le bɛŋ kwe wa fɛ banchi le fede ye yi Kletu le wù ba gɛ ta yi kintaaŋ le. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ kwe noo wu lɛ bɛŋ nyû wa bamii ba muh mu yeye. Muh wuyu wunɛ le wu ba gɛ̀ bvusɛ yi kwe le, wu lɛ besabɛŋ chêe wa bee gee nyume mwɛɛ mù joŋe fɛ Nyo le.

Sege besabɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ bee chee bee bii no nyaŋ yi ye yese besebɛŋ goone, banchi gɛ̀ bee bo kaŋse ye yese besabɛŋ yî fuu ki yi gêe bimbefɛ, yi gee bimbe biɛsa besabɛŋ bi ye bì lɛne mwɛɛ mù too nyume bɛ kwe fɛ besabɛŋ le.

Geenɛ, mɛɛse besabɛŋ le be bu wa a nchi kuu, bee kwe bee ga bɛ banchi bayu ba gɛ̀ shee bo kaane besabɛŋ. Besabɛŋ le be bu wu lɛ besabɛŋ lɛ̂ne antɛnɛɛ a kinche kifɛŋ ki Kiyo ki Yuude, ya nyu gɛ a je yì kege yì banchi ba bo gɛ̀ saŋ le gɛ.
Nchi gee besabɛŋ kee mwɛɛ mù mbefe

Taŋlo besabɛŋ du lɛ la kune nchi? Fɛnɛ le lɛ nchi le fiɛɛ fì befe? Gɛ nyume noo gɛ! Gɛ̀ bee gɛ nje nchi gɛ, tu mbe ŋkee gɛ fiɛɛ fì befe gɛ. Nɛ nchi gɛ̀ baaŋ jɛmɛ gɛ lɛ, “Keefɛ muh ndêfe ajii yi fiɛɛ fi muh mu le gɛ”, tu ŋgɛ̀ mbaaŋ ŋkɛɛ gɛ lɛ ki muh ndefe ajii le fiɛɛ fì befe gɛ.
Noo, kimbefɛ mo kibɛɛ a nchi wunɛ kuu ki gwenyɛ ajii a ndefe ye yaŋ le jé le jé le. Nɛ nchi be bee gɛ yu gɛ, tu kimbefɛ bee ka kɛmɛ gɛ bvuŋga gɛ.
Ŋgɛ̀ nshee nchee, nchi baaŋ a to gɛ. Geenɛ no nchi gɛ̀ to kimbefɛ kaŋsɛ lo, mɛ mo ŋkwe.
Banchi bayu kibɛɛ ba gɛ̀ bee lɛ bo to bɛ kinche, bo tu bo to nyume bɛ kwe fɛ mɛne.
Fì le lɛ kimbefɛ gɛ̀ kɛmɛ je fe yi banchi banɛ le, ki lɛɛ bɛ mɛ, ki bɛɛ yo a kuu ki yuuyɛ mɛ.
Noo banchi le fiɛɛ fì yuude, fiɛɛ fì banchi jɛme nyume fiɛɛ fì yuude, fi nyu chaaŋ fi ka joŋe.

Fi fɛnɛ nyume lɛ fiɛɛ fì joŋe fi ka fi to nyume bɛ kwe fɛ mɛne? Gɛ nyu noo gɛ! Gɛ̀ bee kimbefɛ kì gɛ̀ to ki bɛɛ a fiɛɛ fì joŋe finɛ kuu fì gɛ̀ to bɛ kwe fɛ mɛne, wu lɛ besabɛŋ yɛŋ lɛ kimbefɛ le kimbefɛ, ki duunyi nyume yi fiɛɛ fì banchi duu le lɛ kimbefɛ befe baaŋ.
Bvuju bvu ye yi muh le
Besabɛŋ kee lɛ banchi le fiɛɛ fì ja fɛ Nyo le. Geenɛ nle fiaŋ muh wu wuŋ ŋkɛme nyaŋ yi ye, ba gesɛ mɛ njɛ nfwa kimbefɛ le.
Gɛ ŋgee fiɛɛ ŋkee fiɛɛ fì ŋgee gɛ, nje fiɛɛ fì ŋgoone ki ŋge gɛ nyume fi fì ŋgee gɛ. Ŋka njade ŋge fiɛɛ nyu gɛ fi fì mbanɛ.
No njade ntu ŋgee fiɛɛ nyume gɛ fi ŋgoone gɛ, tu nle mbɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ nchi le fiɛɛ fì joŋe.
No fi le noo, tu le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ gɛ ka gee mɛ fiɛɛ fiyu gɛ. Gee wa nyu kimbefɛ ki le yi ye yaŋ le.
Ŋkee lo lɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì joŋe nyume ye yaŋ le gɛ. Fì le lɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì joŋe nyume yi kilɛmɛ kaŋ le gɛ. Njade ntu ŋkɛme kiŋkoŋɛ ki ŋge fiɛɛ fì kooji, geenɛ gɛ taŋlo ŋge gɛ.
Gɛ fiɛɛ fì joŋe fì ŋgoone ki ŋge nyume fi fì ŋgee gɛ. Fiɛɛ fì befe fì ŋgoone gɛ ki ŋge gɛ, le fi fì ntu ŋgee.
No njade ntu ŋgee fiɛɛ nyu gɛ fi fì ŋgoone gɛ, tu gɛ ka nyume mɛ wù gee fiɛɛ fiyu gɛ. Gee wa nyu kimbefɛ ki le ye yaŋ le.
No fi le noo, mɛ mo n'yɛŋ lɛ le wa lo nchi lɛ sege ŋkoŋe ki ŋge fiɛɛ fì joŋe, fi chige nyume gɛ ki ŋge nyu fì befe.
A mɛ shɛŋ le n'yuge njoŋ bɛ nchi wù Nyo baaŋ.
Geenɛ njade n'yɛne nchi wumu le wu nyume ye yaŋ le. Wuwɛɛ tune jɛŋ bɛ nchi wù le yi ŋkwajɛ waŋ le, wu gee ntuu nfwa wu nchi wu kimbefɛ kì le ye yaŋ le.
Fiŋkfusa fi fiɛɛ njɛ mɛ! Le bvûsɛ yɛɛŋ mɛ nyaŋ yi ye yinɛ yì too bɛ kwe le?

Kiyonɛ ki Nyo wù taŋlo wu fîh mɛ fede yi Jiso Kletu wù Tada wese besabɛŋ le! No fi le noo mɛ mo ntu nyume wa mɛɛse nfwa wu banchi ba Nyo a ŋkwajɛ waŋ le. Geenɛ ntu nyu nfwa wu banchi ba kimbefɛ yi nyaŋ yi ye le.
